title: 中国AI实验室：模型开发追到帕累托前沿，盈利压力怎么破
speaker: Sunny Bagnia

segments.en: yeah so I think it's it's you're seeing quite a bit of a knee jerk reaction now sunny what about when it comes to some of these Chinese startups that are very much in this sort of cutthroat competition right now within China to develop their models do you think that there's going to be any sort of willingness for them to also sit on the pace of AI development or do you think they could actually stand to benefit for the fact that some of these us players are now slowing down
segments.zh: 是的，现在看到不少条件反射式的反应。Sunny，那中国的一些初创公司呢？它们在中国开发模型方面竞争非常激烈。你认为它们是否也愿意放慢AI开发步伐，还是说它们可能因美国一些参与者放缓而受益？

segments.en: yeah no that's right I mean the Chinese look you know they've done a great job with their model development by catching up it to that into that middle layer bottom to middle layer in terms of the Pareto Frontier in terms of AI models
segments.zh: 是的，没错。中国在模型开发方面做得很好，在AI模型的帕累托前沿中，从底层到中间层都追赶了上来。

segments.en: the issue that the Chinese AI labs face is a profitability problem none of them make any none of them make any profits and so they are they are burning free cash flow very quickly they're all negative free cash for their businesses and so they constantly tapping the capital markets for that funding
segments.zh: 中国AI实验室面临的问题是盈利难题，它们都没有盈利，自由现金流消耗很快，业务自由现金流均为负，因此不断向资本市场寻求融资。

segments.en: they've got to work out a way to get to what's profitability and you know last week deep seeks price cuts just puts more pressure across the AI lab to you know generate cash and puts pressure on the underlying cash balances on the balance sheet
segments.zh: 它们必须找到实现盈利的路径。上周DeepSeek的降价进一步给AI实验室带来创收压力，也对其资产负债表上的现金余额构成压力。

segments.en: so I think the AI labs in China need to stay very fast in terms of their AI model developments they're competing quite intensely with one another and need to work out a framework to profitability over time so that they can self-fund their capex which is which is probably been more of their problem
segments.zh: 所以我认为中国的AI实验室需要在模型开发上保持非常快的节奏，它们彼此竞争激烈，需要制定逐步实现盈利的框架，以便能自筹资本开支，这可能是它们更大的问题。
